name: El Vellón (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with a white watchtower.
history: El Vellón adopted its arms and flag officially in 1992, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 5 May 1992; the flag is rectangular of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal horizontal stripes, red above and green below, charged at the centre with a watchtower.
